invariants.rationale: Method returns fileHandle and throws on invalid cases; never returns null.
Throws exception if fileHandle does not exist before returning; guaranteed to exist.
tmjFile is used as argument; null would cause undefined behavior, so expected non-null.
Typically, atlas files are files, not directories. Directory would likely not pass exists() check in practice.
Returned atlas file should have '.atlas' suffix as the method is to retrieve an 'atlas' file.
